content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and typography can weaken Anthropic-branded artifacts. This skill supplies exact palette values, font rules, fallbacks, and accent guidance.
actual_capabilities: Provides exact hexadecimal values for four main colors and three accent colors.
Maps Poppins to headings and Lora to body text.
Defines Arial and Georgia as fallback fonts.
Guides readable text color selection for light and dark backgrounds.
Assigns orange, blue, and green accents to non-text shapes.
Documents RGB color use with the python-pptx RGBColor class.
limitations: The guidance covers the Anthropic visual identity only.
Poppins and Lora must already be installed for exact typography.
The skill provides instructions but includes no automation script or asset templates.
The included license does not grant general permission to use Anthropic trademarks.

use_cases.title: Style a client presentation
use_cases.description: Apply Anthropic colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and accents to an existing presentation.

use_cases.title: Standardize product documentation
use_cases.description: Create consistent typography and color decisions across technical guides and internal documents.

use_cases.title: Implement branded slide generation
use_cases.description: Translate the documented palette into RGBColor settings for generated PowerPoint slides.

prompt_templates.title: Apply basic branding
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this artifact using the Anthropic color palette and typography rules. Preserve the existing content hierarchy.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs consistent brand styling for an existing artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Review visual compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this design against the Anthropic brand guidelines. List color, typography, readability, and accent issues with specific corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs a focused compliance review.

prompt_templates.title: Define a reusable theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable theme specification from these guidelines. Include semantic color roles, font mappings, fallbacks, and shape accent rotation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs shared design tokens for repeated work.

prompt_templates.title: Plan presentation automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a python-pptx styling plan for this presentation. Map each slide element to fonts, RGB colors, contrast rules, and fallback behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs an implementation-ready presentation plan.

output_examples.input: Restyle a product update presentation with a light background and clear section headings.
output_examples.output: Use the light brand background with dark body text. Set headings in Poppins, body text in Lora, and key shapes in orange.

output_examples.input: Review a document that uses blue body text and several unrelated fonts.
output: Replace blue body text with the dark main color for readability.
Use Poppins for headings and Lora for body text.

output_examples.input: Prepare styling guidance when the preferred fonts are unavailable.
output_examples.output: Use Arial for headings and Georgia for body text. Keep the documented color roles and maintain strong foreground contrast.

best_practices: Confirm the artifact background before selecting a readable text color.
Use accent colors for emphasis and non-text shapes, not long body text.
Verify font availability and apply the documented fallbacks when needed.
anti_patterns: Do not replace exact palette values with visually similar colors.
Do not use every accent color with equal weight on each page.
Do not treat brand styling as permission to alter approved content or trademarks.

faq.question: Which heading font should I use?
faq.answer: Use Poppins for headings. Use Arial when Poppins is unavailable.

faq.question: Which body font should I use?
faq.answer: Use Lora for body text. Use Georgia when Lora is unavailable.

faq.question: Does the skill install fonts?
faq.answer: No. The preferred fonts must already be installed in the working environment.

faq.question: Can I apply these rules to presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes color and typography rules suitable for presentations and mentions python-pptx RGBColor.

faq.question: How should accent colors be used?
faq.answer: Use orange as the primary accent, blue as secondary, and green as tertiary. Apply them mainly to non-text shapes.

faq.question: Does the license grant trademark permission?
faq.answer: No. The Apache license states that it does not grant general permission to use licensor trademarks.
